heading: Get paid, sell packages, and manage your inventory
description: All from the same platform — no separate spreadsheets, no manual processes.

features.title: Get paid for bookings online
features.description: Accept a deposit or full payment when clients book, with credit/debit card (processing fee applies) or a manual bank transfer confirmation, no fee.

features.title: Session packages
features.description: Sell prepaid packages — like 4 massage sessions — and the system automatically deducts each session your client uses.

features.title: Store and inventory
features.description: Sell products from your booking page and track your business's supply inventory, using the same payment methods you use for bookings.

footnote: Payments, store, and inventory are available from the Basic plan. Session packages are exclusive to the Own Brand plan. <link>See all features →</link>
